scope: P0 language and action telemetry only
postgres: PostgreSQL 17.6 on x86_64-apple-darwin23.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 16.0.0 (clang-1600.0.26.6), 64-bit

checks.name: additive migrations apply/reapply without changing existing users or another application
service_role CAS update persists and same request replays without a new revision
stale requests conflict rather than overriding explicit language
concurrent changes at the same revision allow exactly one winner
other account is isolated and invalid input cannot mutate stored choices
real attached UI stages persist once and retain the first observation
foreign account, unrelated card and invented payment success cannot be acknowledged
RLS and direct RPC grants reject anon/authenticated even with forged owner/service claims
safe rollback revokes new callers without deleting data; reapply restores access
admin overview is server aggregated, unknown costs remain null and private user content is excluded
completed and failed user requests differ from provider calls; paid Stars exclude failures and non-XTR payments
admin pagination and literal search do not leak a full directory, invalid filters fail closed
no role is assigned automatically and database clients cannot invoke admin aggregates
